items.name: 10 degree wedge backboard with iPad insertion channel
items.selection_reason: Single printed wedge, contained rounded pocket, and full-width flat-bottom channel with parallel walls inclined rearward 20 degrees from vertical. Default mouth width along slope 10 mm, normal depth 8 mm, bottom forward offset 4.6188 mm; normal wall clearance 8.6603 mm.

risks.description: Channel dimensions are editable defaults. Exact iPad/case fit, load capacity and tip resistance require physical verification; no specific iPad model is certified.
